name: gemus
description: Build node-based AI design workflows on the Gemus canvas from your own Codex. Describe a workflow in plain language and Gemus creates the nodes, generates images/video/3D/PPT, and opens the result at gemus.ai.

interface.shortDescription: AI design workflows on the Gemus canvas
interface.longDescription: Gemus is a visual AI design workflow platform. This plugin adds a default-disabled Companion MCP server plus a Stop hook and skills so your local Codex can build workflows, run AI generation, and automatically backfill Codex's own image generations onto planned canvas nodes. Set GEMUS_KEY in your user environment, explicitly enable the plugin-scoped Companion when you are ready, then trust the Stop hook with /hooks. View results at gemus.ai.
defaultPrompt: Use Gemus to build a workflow for a coffee brand identity.
Ask Gemus to generate a hero image and open the canvas.
